correctness.rationale: In each nontrivial tree choose one oriented root edge; its endpoints have q(q-1) distinct color choices. Each other vertex inherits one predecessor neighbor of fixed color different from its own. Properness excludes the vertex’s color from its children. To make predecessor color odd in its neighborhood, its number among remaining d-1 labeled children must be even; each other q-2 available color has zero or odd positive multiplicity. Therefore the labeled-child exponential generating function is cosh(z)(1+sinh(z))^{q-2}, and multiplying its coefficient by (d-1)! exactly counts the children’s assignments. Acyclicity makes child sets disjoint and each vertex nonroot exactly one child, giving a bijection; isolates contribute q. With q=3, cosh z+sinh(2z)/2 gives f_d(3)=1 for odd d and 2^{d-2} for even d; q=2 handles odd-degree trees. Independent direct color enumeration (testing actual neighbor color counts, not the EGF) agrees on 39 unlabeled-tree/palette cases n2..6, q2,3,4. General validity is bijective, not extrapolated.

originality.rationale: The nearest earlier tree theorem (Caro, Petruševski, Škrekovski, Tuza arXiv:2410.02336v1, Proposition 2.1) asserts the least number of colors is ≤3 and gives a 2-color criterion, not the number of all named-palette colorings. The 2026 block-graph algorithm similarly concerns minimum color, and Kwon/Park’s introduction concerns bounds. Thus the all-q local EGF factorization and unexpected degree-multiset invariance are not implications of those minima. A targeted Resultary search retrieved ordinary odd-coloring and other polynomial problems but no corresponding strong-odd forest enumerator.

value.rationale: A full proper strong-odd counting polynomial for every forest is a natural combinatorial invariant, stronger than the known chromatic-number dichotomy. Its degree-only dependence, independent of forest isomorphism type, is a structural phenomenon; the explicit local coefficient formula and q=3 closed count are usable for entire parameter families, not mere tiny numerical checks.
